Definition: a master; hence, a husband, or (figuratively) owner (often used with another noun in modifications of this latter sense)
BiblicalUsage: 1) owner, husband, lord; 1a) owner; 1b) a husband; 1c) citizens, inhabitants; 1d) rulers, lords; 1e) (noun of relationship used to characterise-ie, master of dreams); 1f) lord (used of foreign gods)
